items.title: Inside a context graph: how agents connect the dots across work
items.summary: Agents need more than access to your tools. They need connected context that shows how work fits together, and where the boundaries are. An account team is preparing a customer renewal, and the customer is asking for a discount beyond standard policy. The contract and the discount policy sit in different systems.
